name: Azure Umbra
description: Strike with a palm cloaked in the shadow of a hawk's wing so the blow comes down from the dim.

name: Black Pinion
description: Turn a cut aside with an arm trailing a black pinion that carries the edge off line.

name: Dark Updraft
description: Rise on a column of cool shade and land lightly a pace behind the foe's shoulder.

name: Raptor Shade
description: Dive on the foe with the shadow of the whole body falling first and strike on its heels.

name: Pinion Veil
description: Hold both arms wide with black pinions of dark that turn blows from the front and the sides.

name: Sky Dimming
description: Dim the sky above the foes with a spreading wing so they lose the light and the sense of height.

name: Hawk Eclipse
description: Drop onto the foe from a height in a wide cold shadow and break the guard with the landing.

name: Black Sky Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a mantle of black sky that turns blows and cloaks the user from view.

name: Plunging Dark
description: Gather the dark of the whole field above the foe then let it plunge as one black hawk that crushes him.

name: Side Dimming
description: Dim the light on one side of a foe and watch him turn his head to the wrong court.

name: Dual Murk
description: Throw two blows from two angles that both carry a haze of murk into the foe's eyes.

name: Twin Mantle
description: Raise a mantle of dark at each shoulder so a blow from either side meets one.

name: Turning Slip
description: Slip from one court of dark to the other with a step that leaves the foe facing air.

name: Verdict Dark
description: Pass judgement on one foe with a heavy dark that settles on his limbs and bears them down.

name: Matched Blows
description: Land two equal blows at once from either court and let their weight meet inside the foe.

name: Angled Guard
description: Stand two walls of dark at an angle before the body and hold them as one firm guard.

name: Absolute Dim
description: Dim the whole fighting ground to the edge of blindness and press every foe in it low.

name: Judging Dark
description: Drive a narrow spear of dark through the guard to the one point where the foe is weakest.

name: Extinguishing Verdict
description: Pass the paired verdict through the qi field and put out the foe's strength where no guard can stand.

name: Dark Gather
description: Hollow the belly and let dark qi pool in it so each later blow has more behind it.

name: Curved Catch
description: Hold both hands curved before the chest and catch a blow in the hollow they make.

name: Pour Palm
description: Tip the palm and let the pooled dark spill out through it in a heavy push.

name: Lowering Step
description: Step so the weight settles into the heel like water finding a low place.

name: Pooled Sense
description: Let the pooled dark ripple outward and read the other bodies from how the surface moves.

name: Brimming Dark
description: Fill the basin to the brim and carry the full weight of it through every limb for a time.

name: Overflow Murk
description: Let the brimming murk spill from the raised palms across the ground before the user.

name: Plug Seal
description: Cap a foe's channel of qi with a plug of still dark so that his technique stops short.

name: Rim Burst
description: Break the rim of the basin outward all at once in a ring of dark that bursts from the user.

name: Depth Draw
description: Draw the foe's strength down into the basin through the feet until he stands hollow.

name: Black Overflow
description: Pour the whole basin over the rim through the qi field until a flood of dark covers the foes.

name: Ink Flick
description: Flick a stream of dark ink from the fingers that runs thin across the face of the foe.

name: Current Cloak
description: Let a slow current of dark flow round the body and quicken every limb it passes.

name: Eddy Step
description: Turn in a small eddy of dark and come out of it a pace to the side.

name: Dark Current
description: Send a broad current of dark along the ground that sweeps the feet from under those it meets.

name: Black Drag
description: Drag at a foe's ankles with a pull of dark he cannot step against.

name: Steep Shade
description: Raise a steep bank of shade to turn the river's rush from the user and the allies.

name: Black Torrent
description: Pour a hard torrent of dark over the ground before the user that batters all that stand there.

name: Drowning Dark
description: Raise the dark to the chest of a foe and hold it there until he cannot lift his arms.

name: Lightless Flood
description: Open the river's banks through the qi field and send a lightless flood over the whole ground.

name: Mirror Umbra
description: Strike while a second shadow strikes in step beside the first and draws the foe's eye.

name: Second Shadow
description: Cast a second shadow beside the body that moves a breath behind and shares the strain.

name: Twinned Guard
description: Let the second shadow take half of a blow while the body takes the rest on the arms.

name: Echo Step
description: Step and leave the second shadow behind to hold the foe's eye while the body moves on.

name: Twin Gaze
description: See through the eyes of the second shadow and watch the foe's back from where it stands.

name: Shadow Double
description: Send the second shadow wandering about the foe so that he cannot tell which one is the user.

name: Split Umbra
description: Strike from two places at once with the body and the shadow so one blow must land.

name: Shadowmate Guard
description: Stand the body and its shadow shoulder to shoulder and hold one wide wall of dark.

name: Doubled Veil
description: Hang a veil over the foes from the body and another from the shadow so sight fails twice.

name: Umbra Pair
description: Throw the body and its shadow in two arcs across the ground and strike every foe between.

name: Mirrored Dusk
description: Mirror a foe's own shadow back at him until his stance and his qi flow lose their rhythm.

name: Paired Phase
description: Pass from the body into the shadow and out of it at another place through the qi field.

name: Unseen Step
description: Step along the heading with no light on the foot and no sound from the ground.

name: Oathed Palm
description: Push a palm out along the sworn heading in a blow no one saw begin.

name: Bearing Veil
description: Drop a veil of dark across the heading to stop a thrust and hide the way travelled.

name: Quiet Heading
description: Hold a hush of dark qi along the heading so the body gives off no trace as it goes.

name: Heading Hush
description: Still the air in front of a foe along the heading until his arms feel bound in silence.

name: Wind Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of dark that rides the wind and blows aside whatever is thrown at it.

name: Heading Slash
description: Cut straight along the heading with a blade of dark that ends exactly where it was sworn to.

name: Hidden Bearing
description: Hide the heading itself so foes see the user at the start and then at the end and never between.

name: Sworn Dark
description: Loose the whole sworn dark in a straight blow that carries on past a broken guard.

name: Unseen Passage
description: Pass along the heading through the qi field out of sight and come out where it ends.

name: Bare Eclipse
description: Throw a small black disc plainly across the open ground to strike the chest with a cold bite.

name: Open Cloak
description: Wear the dark open and wide at the shoulders so the body moves lighter in it.

name: Sweeping Guard
description: Sweep the arm in a wide arc and send a blow wide with a flat wave of dark.

name: Open Eclipse
description: Cover a wide front with a thin eclipse that dims and chills every foe under it.

name: Stripped Cover
description: Rip a foe's own concealing technique from him and leave him lit and plain to see.

name: Broad Pall
description: Spread a broad pall over the ground until no foe can find a landmark to stand by.

name: Eclipse Spread
description: Widen the eclipse until it blots out the whole front and bites at all it covers.

name: Blotted Light
description: Blot out every glow of qi under the eclipse so that foes' techniques gutter and fade.

name: Total Eclipse
description: Pull the full eclipse over the ground through the qi field and crush all beneath it.

name: Quench Palm
description: Strike with a palm that drinks the glow from whatever it touches.

name: Snuffing Step
description: Step over a lamp and leave it out behind you with a stamp of dark.

name: Lamp Sense
description: Read the lamps and glows in a place and mark which belong to bodies and which to things.

name: Wick Guard
description: Pinch aside a bolt of bright qi with fingers that put out its wick.

name: Light Dim
description: Draw the strength from every nearby glow until sight is poor for a breath.

name: Snuffing Wave
description: Push a wave of dark across the ground that puts out every small flame in its path.

name: Dark Hold
description: Close a fist of dark on a foe's glowing technique and shut it away until it dies.

name: Ash Veil
description: Hold a veil of grey ash-dark that smothers bright strikes where they meet it.

name: Dead Glow
description: Leave a dead glow on a foe's body so that his qi techniques come out dull and slow.

name: Extinguishing Press
description: Press the dark on a single foe until every glow within him sinks toward the last spark.

name: Lamp Eater
description: Swallow a foe's channelled technique whole and break the flow of his qi at the source.

name: Black Out
description: Take every light in the field at once so friend and foe alike fight in perfect black.

name: Final Quench
description: Gather the dark through the qi field and shut the last light in a foe's body away.

name: Taking Palm
description: Strike and draw back in the same motion so the blow takes a share of the foe's strength.

name: Absorb Step
description: Step through the sound of the foe's own move and take it in as the foot lands.

name: Drinking Cloak
description: Draw the stray light about the body into the cloak so it deepens with every breath.

name: Gulp Guard
description: Take a blow into a hollow of dark and let it vanish into the folds of the cloak.

name: Light Drain
description: Drain the glow from the foe's weapon and armour until they hang dull and heavy.

name: Sunken Draw
description: Draw blows into a deep well of dark before the chest where they lose their force.

name: Sworn Gulp
description: Strike hard with the strength of the dark already drunk and held back for this blow.

name: Devouring Bearing
description: Open a wide mouth of dark along the heading that eats the light and the breath of foes.

name: Held Hunger
description: Hold the absorbed dark without loosing it and let it lend the next strikes a steady edge.

name: Total Absorption
description: Open the whole field to every blow and every light that comes and take them in without a sound.

name: Unfelt Step
description: Step so lightly and so dim that trained qi sense does not mark the movement.

name: Mask Dark
description: Smooth the qi flow of the body to a flat calm and mask it under a layer of dark.

name: Null Palm
description: Strike with a palm that gives off no qi trace until the instant that it lands.

name: Smooth Guard
description: Slide a blow aside with a forearm that has no edge for the foe to read.

name: Blind Scan
description: Probe quietly for the sense of any watcher near and learn where their attention lies.

name: Hidden Breath
description: Keep the breath and heartbeat inside the cloak of dark so that no sense can mark them.

name: Sense Fog
description: Spread a fog of dark qi that fills the foe's own sense with false and empty readings.

name: Ghost Cut
description: Cut from the hidden stance in the instant the foe's attention turns away.

name: Past Sensing
description: Cancel the trace of the body completely for a time so even close sense reads an empty place.

name: Veiled Strike
description: Strike out of perfect concealment so the blow lands on a foe who never marked the user.

name: Absolute Hiding
description: Pass beyond all sense through the qi field and stand unmarked in the middle of the foes.
